findings.quote: Which word best describes the author's tone toward modern commercial developers in Vigan?
findings.problem: The stem asks for one word, but every choice contains two adjectives joined by “and.”

findings.question: q-comprehension-skills-authors-purpose-tone-pov-0019
findings.quote: This treats the presence of two projects as a cost comparison. Ben also brings a model. Check whether prices are given.
findings.problem: The note assumes Ben brings a model, but the passage identifies his work only as a project. It could be a poster or an experiment without changing any stated event. The wrong-choice note should rely on details actually supplied.
findings.fix: Replace “Ben also brings a model” with “Ben also brings a project.”
